items.proposed: H3K27M exploratory_correlative (conditional exclusion restricting only H3 K27M-mutant diffuse gliomas), not eligibility
items.reason: The exclusion "Patients with H3 K27M-mutant diffuse gliomas are excluded unless the primary tumor is located in the pons or spinal cord..." restricts only the H3 K27M diffuse glioma (non-GBM) group; glioblastoma patients enter without it, so under D31-A1 the row is exploratory_correlative rather than A4 eligibility. Excluding H3K27M-altered tumours also falls under the D31-A5 exemption for GBM.

No eligibility or enrichment biomarker remains once the H3K27M conditional exclusion is not counted. The record lists a broad set of "recurrent, primary CNS neoplasm" types with no molecular entry requirement.

note: Under D31-B15 the population is basket_gbm_eligible (still included). The H3K27M exclusion is coded exploratory_correlative under D31-A1 (and is A5-exempt), so any_molecular_selection stays false and no A6 question arises.

revisions.reason: Inclusion lists glioblastoma alongside non-glioma CNS neoplasms ("medulloblastoma ... atypical teratoid/rhabdoid tumor ... atypical and anaplastic meningiomas, choroid plexus tumors, and pineal region tumors").
The H3 K27M exclusion applies only to the diffuse-midline/histone-mutant glioma group, while glioblastoma patients enter without it.
